faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: A marketplace where hairdressers, salons and massage therapists publish an empty hour at a discount. You book that hour, not a random slot in a diary.
faq.a2: The business enters the usual price and the last-minute price. GatVuller does not invent a percentage or a number of places left.
faq.a3: Only when Stripe confirms the payment. Returning to the site is not enough. Without Stripe keys the platform runs in test mode and the confirmation says so.
faq.q4: What does it cost a business?
faq.a4: No subscription. {percent}% of the last-minute price, calculated on the server. The customer pays no extra fee.
faq.a5: Until the window the business sets, 2 hours before the start by default. After that, and for a no-show, there is no refund.
faq.a6: With Leaflet and OpenStreetMap. No separate map key is required.

legal.termsDesc: Terms for customers and businesses on GatVuller.
legal.privacyDesc: Which data GatVuller processes, which processors are involved, and how to request your data.
legal.intro: {brand} ({legal}, {address}) is a marketplace. Local providers publish a free hour at their own price. Customers reserve that hour and pay online. GatVuller is not a party to the treatment itself.
legal.offer: A business may publish only an hour that is actually free, with a usual price and a lower last-minute price. Invented scarcity, or a price that does not follow the business’s own price list, may be removed.
legal.pay: The customer pays the last-minute price. There is no extra platform surcharge. The business pays a {percent}% platform fee, calculated on the server. That fee also covers Stripe’s charges. Card details are processed by Stripe and are not stored by GatVuller. A booking is paid only when Stripe confirms it.
legal.cancel: A customer can cancel until the number of hours the business sets (2 by default) before the start. Stripe then refunds the payment. After that window, and for a no-show, the amount stays paid: the hour was reserved. The business can cancel until the hour ends; the customer is then refunded. A no-show is recorded only after the hour has started and the customer was not checked in.
legal.reviews: A review is possible only after a paid visit. GatVuller may hide a review that is abusive or not about the visit.
legal.payout: Businesses receive their share through Stripe Connect. GatVuller does not hold card balances.
legal.data: Account: name, email, password hash, role and language. Booking: name, email, optional phone, the hour and the amount paid. Business: name, address, coordinates, photos, opening hours and Stripe account id. We do not store card numbers. Location used for distance stays on your device and is not sent in the URL.
legal.why: To reserve an hour, prevent fraud and double bookings, tell the business who is coming, and pay out. Analytics stores only an event name, not a name or email.
legal.rights: Bookings are kept for as long as payment, disputes and accounting require. You can ask for access, correction or erasure via {privacy} or your account page. Erasure anonymises the account: the booking remains without an identifiable name, because the payment requires it. You can complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority.
legal.processors: Hosting: Vercel. Database: the PostgreSQL host configured for this environment. Payments: Stripe (Checkout and Connect). Email: Resend, when it is configured. Map tiles: OpenStreetMap. Photos: Vercel Blob, when uploads are enabled.

business.title: For businesses
business.lead: GatVuller sells your empty hour. You set the treatment, the usual price and the last-minute price.
business.fee: No subscription. GatVuller charges {percent}% of the last-minute price. That fee includes Stripe’s charges: you see the net amount in your dashboard, next to the extra revenue.
business.how: Register your business. We check the company number. Then connect Stripe. Pick a template or enter the title, duration and prices, and put the hour online. That takes under a minute once the template is ready.
business.policy: The customer may cancel until the window you set. Not after that. A no-show is not refunded. If you cancel, the customer is refunded.
